# pve_node_dns (Resource)

Node DNS resolver configuration (singleton).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_dns" "example" {
  node   = "pve1"
  search = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `search` (String) Search domain for host-name lookup.

### Optional

- `dns1` (String) First name server IP address.
- `dns2` (String) Second name server IP address.
- `dns3` (String) Third name server IP address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node (also the `terraform import` format).
